title: The Psychology of the Child
author: Jean Piaget and Bärbel Inhelder
rights: Owner-supplied reference; not redistributed
assigned: Chapter I: sensorimotor intelligence and learning through action. Selected chapter III: symbols, play and drawing; chapter IV: concrete operations and interpersonal relations.
note: Chapter I describes infancy. We use it to reflect on active learning, not to label schoolchildren. Observe the individual learner; this historical theory is not a diagnosis.

title: Chisanbop: supplied practice extract
author: Owner-supplied extract; edition/author not established from this excerpt
rights: Private reference; not redistributed
assigned: PDF pages 1–5: finger values and simultaneous representation; pages 6 onward: introductory addition.
note: The extract starts partway through a book. Rehearse against the diagrams; do not invent the missing advanced material.

title: Learn to Program with Scratch
author: Majed Marji, No Starch Press, 2014
rights: Owner-supplied copyrighted reference; not redistributed
assigned: Opening programming concepts: scripts, sequence, events, repetition and decisions.
note: This edition uses Scratch 2. Use current Scratch tutorials for the interface; concepts transfer, screenshots may not.

title: Scratch ideas and tutorials
author: Scratch Foundation
rights: Official free learning resource; link to publisher
assigned: Animate a name/story and create a simple game; choose only the tutorial needed today.

title: Canva teacher resources and Design School
author: Canva
rights: Official learning resource; link to publisher
assigned: Beginner editor, text, elements, pages, sharing and export. Use free features; do not require a paid subscription.
note: Canva for Education eligibility and school account arrangements must be checked; a trainee does not automatically qualify.

title: Graphic Design and Print Production Fundamentals
author: Graphic Communications Open Textbook Collective / BCcampus, 2015
rights: CC BY 4.0, except where noted
assigned: Chapter 2: define a brief and develop concepts; chapter 3: visual elements, hierarchy, contrast and organisation. Skip industrial print production for this induction.

title: Design basics
author: Figma
rights: Official free articles; link to publisher
assigned: UI/UX, product design, wireframes and prototypes; do not attempt the entire resource library.

title: Learn web development
author: Mozilla / MDN contributors
rights: Official documentation; link to publisher
assigned: Getting started; semantic HTML; CSS fundamentals; JavaScript events and decisions. Follow the current examples.

title: Introduction to Python Programming
author: OpenStax
rights: Publisher-authorised free web/PDF edition; retain original notices
assigned: Variables, expressions, conditionals and loops only; practise a tiny input-to-output program.

title: Beginning Excel 2019
author: Noreen Brown, Barbara Lave, Hallie Puncochar, Julie Romey, Mary Schatz, Art Schneider and Diane Shingledecker
rights: CC BY 4.0 in the publisher edition, except where noted
assigned: Sections 1.2–1.3, 2.1–2.2, 4.1 and 5.1: clean records, formulas, charts and tables.
note: The interface is older; verify commands in the Excel version available. Do not teach an ordinary spreadsheet as if it were a relational database.

title: Get started building with Power BI
author: Microsoft Learn
rights: Official free training; link to publisher
assigned: Reports, data import and one clear visual. Use fictional data; a simple spreadsheet chart is the low-device fallback.

title: Introduction to Information Systems Management
author: Roy Wood, 2024
rights: CC BY 4.0, except where noted
assigned: Chapters 2–3: networks and service choices; 4: data; 8: cybersecurity; 12–13: project management. Select short sections, not whole chapters.

title: An Introduction to Computer Networks
author: Peter L. Dordal, Loyola University Chicago
rights: Author-provided free reference; CC BY-NC-ND with preface conditions; external reading only
assigned: Opening overview of LANs and internetworking. This is a substantial reference book, not a required full induction reading.

title: The NIST Definition of Cloud Computing — SP 800-145
author: Peter Mell and Timothy Grance, NIST, 2011
rights: Official NIST publication; external reference
assigned: Section 2: compare SaaS, PaaS and IaaS using one familiar service. This is a concise reference, not a practical cloud-provider certification course.

title: The Scrum Guide, November 2020
author: Ken Schwaber and Jeff Sutherland
rights: CC BY-SA 4.0
assigned: Purpose, accountabilities, goals, backlog and review. Our classroom task board is a learning adaptation, not a claim to implement full Scrum.

title: Cybercrimes (Prohibition, Prevention, etc.) Act, 2015
author: Federal Republic of Nigeria; WIPO Lex reference NG058
rights: Official legislative reference; consult current amended text
assigned: Teacher-guided orientation to unauthorised access, misuse, identity and responsible reporting; read alongside the 2024 amendment.
note: The WIPO entry states that the original text is amended and is not a consolidated current text. Do not memorise penalties from the original as current law.

title: Cybercrimes (Prohibition, Prevention, etc.) (Amendment) Act, 2024
author: Federal Republic of Nigeria; WIPO Lex reference NG061
rights: Official legislative reference; read with the 2015 Act
assigned: Locate the provisions that amend the original; distinguish an amendment from a complete replacement.

title: Cybercrimes Act 2015 with Amendment Act 2024 — official PDF
author: Office of the National Security Adviser; hosted by NCC
rights: Official public legislative publication; preserve unmodified; not to be sold
assigned: Use this 56-page official publication to consult the original Act and amendment together. The cover and publication identity were visually checked on 3 November 2026.

title: Cybersecurity resources
author: Nigeria Computer Emergency Response Team (ngCERT)
rights: Official public resources; link to publisher
assigned: Safe browsing, online behaviour and reporting. Teach prevention and escalation, not intrusion exercises on live systems.

title: Principles of Marketing
author: OpenStax
rights: Free publisher web edition; external reference only
assigned: Audience needs, value, research and chapter 16 digital channels. Read selectively; do not copy or redistribute this text inside paid training.

title: Generative AI for educators
author: Google
rights: Official learning resource; external reference
assigned: Prompting, checking outputs, bias and responsible classroom use; use invented examples and protect learner information.
